traffic_model: median_bytes_per_sec is DRAM TRAFFIC per second, not copy size per second, and one timed window is a BURST of copies_per_replicate copies rather than a single copy: each D2D copy of 1073741824 B both reads and writes, moving 2147483648 B through the memory system, so the reported rate is copies_per_replicate * 2147483648 B divided by the elapsed time of the whole window. Reading the window as one copy understates the rate by a factor of copies_per_replicate. This is the quantity a vendor peak names and the quantity per-sequence decode is bounded by.
